title: ste-changed says "unknown" on a shallow clone instead of a false stale-pin warning
why: Named incident, Nov 1 21:4x CST (mailaudit lane): on a shallow claude-settings clone, ste-changed said CI pins ste-lint at 17492e5 "which this copy does not hold", though 17492e5 is an ancestor of main d8037a44. The lane opened an unneeded pin-move lane (cancelled; archived as archive/pin-claude-settings-d8037a4).
note: Cause: git merge-base --is-ancestor exits 1 when history is cut (.git/shallow present, rev-list --count origin/main = 1). Fix: before the ancestry read, deepen (git fetch --unshallow or --deepen to the pin), or report "unknown (shallow clone)", never "does not hold" (rule verification-report-unknown-reads). Red first: a shallow fixture clone whose pin is an ancestor beyond the cut gets no stale-pin warning. Cloud sessions clone shallow (clone_depth 50 by default), so it is likely in normal work. Port: yes, ste-changed is shared. Ready.
